description: This file defines the MediaOptionsConfiguration class which implements IConfigureOptions<MediaOptions>. It configures media-related options such as supported sizes, allowed file extensions, cache durations, security policies, and static file options for the OrchardCore media module.

classes.name: MediaOptionsConfiguration
classes.description: A class that configures MediaOptions settings based on shell configuration, including supported sizes, allowed file extensions, cache policies, and static file options.

methods.name: MediaOptionsConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the configuration with the provided IShellConfiguration.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures MediaOptions instance with settings retrieved from the shell configuration, including cache policies, allowed file types, supported sizes, and static file options.
